audit_metadata.title: Cross-Stage Candidate Comparability Matrix
audit_metadata.friction: 5 bps equity slippage, 10 bps leveraged ETF slippage, 0 commission

Frozen_E0.name: Production Frozen Baseline E0
Frozen_E0.isolated_change: Authoritative production baseline: equal-weighted top 5 momentum winners (budget 0.76 or 0.92), 18% leveraged overlay (QLD 0.11, SSO 0.07 when vol < 0.28), defensive sleeve (XLE 0.12, XLP 0.24, XLU 0.24, XLV 0.20 when risk-off).
Frozen_E0.synthetic_outcomes: 100% compliant across all basic contract tests.
Frozen_E0.statistical_limitations: High drawdown in Tier 2 COVID crash (31.75%); concentration in high-beta tech momentum.

Execution_Safe_Agent_Final.name: Execution-Safe Broker Settlement Agent
Execution_Safe_Agent_Final.isolated_change: Calculates pre-trade buying power with immediate sell settlement credit and dynamic liquidity buffer, preventing Scenario 4 simultaneous order drops.
Execution_Safe_Agent_Final.risk_on_or_off_effect: Execution-layer invariant enforcement (neutral to strategy signals).
Execution_Safe_Agent_Final.synthetic_outcomes: Eliminates 100% of order drop rejections in Scenario 4 without altering fills.
Execution_Safe_Agent_Final.statistical_limitations: Execution harness correction; does not alter macro strategy returns.

Candidate_D1.name: Defensive Energy Exit
Candidate_D1.isolated_change: Removes XLE (0.12) from defensive basket; reallocates proportionally to XLP (0.28), XLU (0.28), XLV (0.24) with 0.20 cash.
Candidate_D1.synthetic_outcomes: Improves defensive drawdown in oil market crashes.
Candidate_D1.statistical_limitations: Underperforms in inflationary or commodity-driven recoveries.

Candidate_D2.name: Defensive 50% Cash Cushion
Candidate_D2.isolated_change: Increases risk-off cash reserve from 20% to 50%; reduces defensive equities proportionally (XLE 0.075, XLP 0.15, XLU 0.15, XLV 0.125).
Candidate_D2.synthetic_outcomes: Reduces Tier 2 MaxDD from 31.75% to 21.20% (-10.55% reduction).
Candidate_D2.statistical_limitations: Mild return drag in Tier 1 ( vs ) due to holding uninvested cash during mild pullbacks.

Candidate_D3.name: Defensive Recovery Discipline
Candidate_D3.isolated_change: Combines D2 50% cash cushion with an accelerated risk-on re-entry rule when QQQ crosses back above its 20-day SMA.
Candidate_D3.synthetic_outcomes: Captures rapid V-shaped recoveries while cutting Tier 2 MaxDD to 21.20%.
Candidate_D3.statistical_limitations: Worsens Tier 1 MaxDD (20.48% vs 19.14% E0) due to whipsaws in false breakout regimes.
Candidate_D3.verdict: INVESTIGATE ONLY WITH NEW INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE

Candidate_C1.name: Tight Volatility Gate (0.22 Threshold)
Candidate_C1.isolated_change: Lowers QQQ realized volatility ceiling for leveraged overlay from 0.28 to 0.22.
Candidate_C1.synthetic_outcomes: Deactivates overlay earlier ahead of mild volatility expansions.
Candidate_C1.statistical_limitations: Trades off 52 bps annual return in Tier 1 for +131 bps in Tier 2; mixed regime sensitivity.
Candidate_C1.verdict: INVESTIGATE ONLY WITH NEW INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE

Candidate_C2.name: Volatility Acceleration Ratio (sigma5 / sigma20 <= 1.25)
Candidate_C2.isolated_change: Adds short-term acceleration gate requiring sigma5 / sigma20 <= 1.25 to maintain overlay.
Candidate_C2.synthetic_outcomes: Severe whipsaw churn: liquidates overlay at the start of sharp upward market rebounds.
Candidate_C2.statistical_limitations: Devastating alpha drag: collapses Tier 2 ending NAV by ,567.56.

Candidate_C3.name: Volatility Persistence Confirmation (2 Sessions)
Candidate_C3.isolated_change: Requires 2 consecutive sessions of sigma > 0.28 before deactivating overlay.
Candidate_C3.synthetic_outcomes: Economically inactive in sample periods: transient 1-day spikes without trend breakdown did not occur.
Candidate_C3.statistical_limitations: 100.000% redundant with Frozen E0 across 1,763 evaluated sessions.

Candidate_C4.name: Combined Volatility Gates (C1 + C2)
Candidate_C4.isolated_change: Combines tight 0.22 threshold with acceleration ratio <= 1.25.
Candidate_C4.synthetic_outcomes: Severe compound drag: inherits all pathology of C2.
Candidate_C4.statistical_limitations: Worst performing volatility candidate across both tiers.

Candidate_P1.name: Pure Inverse-Volatility Sizing
Candidate_P1.isolated_change: Unconstrained risk-on allocation inversely proportional to 20-day realized volatility.
Candidate_P1.synthetic_outcomes: Reduces Tier 1 MaxDD to 14.58% but severely underweights tech momentum winners.
Candidate_P1.statistical_limitations: Massive return drag in Tier 2 (-11.62% CAGR, - NAV).

Candidate_P2.name: Capped Inverse-Volatility with Redistribution
Candidate_P2.isolated_change: Clamps inverse-vol weights at 0.24 cap and iteratively redistributes excess capacity.
Candidate_P2.synthetic_outcomes: Enforces single-asset cap; slightly improves Tier 2 CAGR to 42.47%.
Candidate_P2.statistical_limitations: Still suffers major drag relative to E0 ( vs ).

Candidate_P3.name: Smoothed Inverse-Volatility (alpha = 0.5)
Candidate_P3.isolated_change: Applies 2-period moving-average smoothing filter to 20-day volatility before capping.
Candidate_P3.synthetic_outcomes: Reduces trade churn in synthetic stress; improves Tier 2 CAGR to 44.60%.
Candidate_P3.statistical_limitations: Fails to outperform E0; introduces lag during regime transitions.

Candidate_P4.name: Equal / Inverse-Volatility Blend (50/50)
Candidate_P4.isolated_change: 50/50 convex combination of E0 equal sizing and P2 capped inverse-volatility sizing.
Candidate_P4.synthetic_outcomes: Balanced compromise between drawdown dampening and momentum capture.
Candidate_P4.statistical_limitations: Still underperforms E0 on Sharpe across full market cycles (1.51 vs 1.63 in Tier 2; 1.00 vs 1.13 in Tier 1).
